title: Expense Agent: capture submission policy evaluation history
summary: Expense Agent now captures policy evaluation history at the report level, storing outcomes and flagged categories in the activity log during submission and resubmission with deduplication per submission round.
key_points: Report-level policy evaluation summaries added to expense activity history
Activity logger captures submission/resubmission events and line evaluation confirmations
Passed/failed counts and distinct flagged category codes are stored in activity entries
Category overflow handled with a final '...' array entry for display
Read-only API exposes snapshots and preserves data through posting
quote: Adds report-level policy evaluation summaries to expense activity history.
